title: Secure Webhook Token (SWT) Payload Claims
description: JWT payload schema for Secure Webhook Tokens per IETF draft-knauer-secure-webhook-token-03.

event.description: Webhook event type identifier (e.g. agent.tool.completed, payment.received).

hash.description: Cryptographic hash of raw HTTP POST body in <algorithm>:<hex> format. Required for non-empty bodies, absent for empty bodies.

retry_count.description: Non-negative delivery attempt counter (0 = initial delivery).

aud.description: Intended recipient endpoint or service identifier. RECOMMENDED in general; REQUIRED when using asymmetric signing keys (RS256, ES256) or multi-subscriber delivery per Draft-03.

nbf.description: Not Before time (NumericDate, Unix epoch seconds).

iat.description: Issued At time (NumericDate, Unix epoch seconds).

jti.description: Unique JWT ID (UUID recommended) for replay protection.
